evaluation.input: P80 normalized factual 16D state-action context at recorded pre-state and executed do action, L2 normalized; not action-only source
evaluation.outcome: P80 tanh of four physical deltas / [2.4,3.0,0.2095,3.5], reward tanh, terminated, truncated, padding nine zeros
evaluation.mask: Per world skip first factual event; predict BEFORE incorporating the current observed outcome. Equal weight per episode/world; physical delta MSE only four normalized channels. No padded 16D MSE.
evaluation.arms: Frozen original P78 non_directional3 theta from three seeds 978201/203/207; P78 CAL-selected eta=0.4, zero-output reference; reported trained F4R1 SSM seeds 985201/203/207 matched original CAL64/source/mask
evaluation.ssm_result_source: original F4R1 owner #43080774054; published F5 protocol F4 SHA as quoted
evaluation.metrics: all 64 world MSE and event counts, aggregate equal-world mean, fixed ratio, trained SSM ratio, zero baseline, wrong-credit zero/future negative, cold restoration; full process CPU cost not matched

freeze_tests.primary: For each P78 seed, original pre-trained learned update achieves <=0.9x existing trained F4 SSM delta MSE; AND <=0.9x frozen eta=.4 under identical F3 CAL. Otherwise FAIL for that seed, all3 required.
freeze_tests.negative: Deterministic wrong-action or zero future effects cannot improve by leaking current target; inspect raw probe chronology.
freeze_tests.quality_guard: If source blobs, archive digest, exact worlds, effect counts, normalization or mask drift, fail before scoring; never re-run original F3 collector or F4 trainer.
freeze_tests.risk: F3 CAL has already been used by F4/F5 and P78 toy design was reviewed; THIS IS RETROSPECTIVE EXPLORATION, NOT SCIENTIFIC UNSEEN TEST even if criterion passes.

authority.scope: read-only analysis of already consumed/source witnessed GitHub archive and already trained SSM metrics

report.store_evidence: existing GitHub PR/Actions; not ChatGPT Library
